title: VTC Admin Actions — Acknowledge — payload
description: An administrator acknowledges an `acknowledge`-category action — an operation that already took effect outside the approval path, such as an operator's offline or break-glass write — recording that they have seen it. There is nothing to approve or decline. The outer document members (id, type, issuer, recipient, issuedAt, expiresAt, proof) are owned by the framework — SPEC §6.3.

Response.title: VTC Admin Actions — Acknowledge — response payload
Response.description: The action with the caller's acknowledgement recorded in `approvals`. When the caller was the last administrator expected to acknowledge it, `status` is `completed` and `closedReason` is `acknowledged`. Failures use trust-task-error, not this shape.
